description: This file contains data transformation and augmentation functions for image and bounding box processing in an object detection pipeline, including cropping, flipping, resizing, padding, normalization, and composition of transformations.

classes.name: RandomCrop
classes.description: Class for randomly cropping an image and its target bounding boxes and masks.

classes.name: RandomSizeCrop
classes.description: Class for randomly cropping with size constraints.

classes.name: CenterCrop
classes.description: Class for center cropping an image and its target.

classes.name: RandomHorizontalFlip
classes.description: Class for randomly flipping an image horizontally.

classes.name: RandomResize
classes.description: Class for randomly resizing an image to one of several sizes.

classes.name: RandomPad
classes.description: Class for randomly padding an image.

classes.name: RandomSelect
classes.description: Class for randomly selecting between two transformation pipelines.

classes.name: ToTensor
classes.description: Class for converting an image to tensor format.

classes.name: RandomErasing
classes.description: Class for applying random erasing augmentation.

classes.name: Normalize
classes.description: Class for normalizing image tensors and adjusting bounding boxes accordingly.

classes.name: Compose
classes.description: Class for composing multiple transformations into a pipeline.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops an image and adjusts target bounding boxes and masks accordingly.

methods.name: hflip
methods.description: Horizontally flips an image and updates target bounding boxes and masks.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes an image and scales target bounding boxes and masks.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads an image and updates target size and masks.
